source_note: Technical controls only. This does not cover organizational measures, DPIAs, data subject rights, lawful basis, or processor contracts. Not a substitute for legal compliance assessment.

controls.title: Sensitive data exposure findings below threshold
evidence_requirements: Information exposure scan results (secrets, PII patterns, logging of sensitive data)
No critical sensitive data exposure findings

evidence_checks.reason: Critical sensitive data exposure findings detected
High-severity data exposure findings exceed threshold

controls.title: Data exfiltration findings below threshold
evidence_requirements: No critical or high exfiltration findings

controls.title: Encryption and secure transport controls adequate
evidence_requirements: Cryptographic findings scan (weak algorithms, missing encryption, plaintext transport)

evidence_checks.reason: Critical cryptographic findings (weak encryption, plaintext transport)

controls.title: Third-party dependency inventory exists
evidence_requirements: CycloneDX SBOM generated from project lockfiles
Inventory of all third-party components processing data

evidence_checks.reason: No third-party dependency inventory — SBOM generation found zero components

controls.title: No critical vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies
evidence_requirements: OSV vulnerability scan results for all SBOM components
Zero critical-severity known vulnerabilities in third-party code

controls.title: No hallucinated packages in dependency tree
evidence_requirements: Hallucination check results against official package registries

evidence_checks.reason: Hallucinated (phantom) packages detected — supply chain integrity risk

evidence_checks.not_evaluated_reason: No packages could be verified — all ecosystems unsupported by hallucination checker
